Self.Wiki: A character that uses the Enemy layout but is left out of the Enemy-only setup. It still gets its NPC and Think rows and can be driven by event scripts like any character (Set Character AI State, Change Character Enable State, Set SpEffect, Set Always Draw Character and so on). Unlike an Enemy, the game skips its Talk script, idle animation and 0x48, and it does not join a PlatoonInfo event even when one lists it (platoons take only Enemy and Player parts). Generators can spawn from it. Retail: 466 DummyEnemies; 200 have an Entity ID, 129 of them used by their map's events; 33 are listed by a PlatoonInfo and 2 by a Generator.

Enemy_ActionButtonParamID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for an interaction prompt on this character. -1 for none. Retail: set on 1 DummyEnemy.

NPCParamID.Wiki: The NpcParam row that sets the character's stats and behaviour. Its defaultLodParamId, when 0 or more, replaces the map object's own LOD setting. The game can swap in another row at run time (an override kept on the map object).

ThinkParamID.Wiki: The NpcThinkParam row that sets the character's AI script and senses. The game can swap in another row at run time (an override kept on the map object). Retail: 0 on 14 DummyEnemies, 1 on 4.

CharaInitID.Wiki: The CharaInitParam row that sets an AC's parts and loadout, when greater than 0. The map-load setup step that applies it to an Enemy is skipped for a DummyEnemy; other code also reads it, so whether it applies here is not confirmed. Retail: 10600000 on 3 DummyEnemies (c0xxx).

CollisionPartName.Wiki: A collision whose display groups the character takes at map load. Traced for Enemy parts; not confirmed for a DummyEnemy. Retail: set on 2 DummyEnemies (h002500, h002600).

WalkRouteName.Wiki: The Patrol Route event the character walks. Its Patrol regions give the points, Action IDs and Turn Types. Retail: set on 88 DummyEnemies.

Enemy_Unk22.Wiki: Characters with the same group ID share targets (the game's own debug label for it is 'Target Sharing Group ID'; how far the sharing goes was not traced). Two characters count as grouped only when both values are above 0 and equal. -1 for none. Whether a DummyEnemy is gathered into a group (traced for Enemy parts) is not confirmed. Retail: set on 48 DummyEnemies.

Enemy_LinkedEntityID.Wiki: The Entity ID of another character or asset this one belongs to, such as the unit it is mounted on. A short ID (below 10000) is expanded to the map's full entity ID at load, like every entity ID. 0 for none. No reader of the value was found, so its effect is not confirmed. Retail: set on 89 DummyEnemies (39 name an asset, 24 an Enemy, 16 another DummyEnemy).

Enemy_Unk44.Wiki: No reader found. Set mostly on characters with a Parent Entity ID, with small values that look like dummy poly IDs on the parent's model. -1 for none. Retail: set on 91 DummyEnemies.

Enemy_Unk55.Wiki: Overrides one setup step of the character. 0: the step runs unless a flag on the character's component blocks it. 1: never runs. 2: always runs. What the step does was not traced. Retail: 0 on every DummyEnemy.

KillPayoutClassification.Wiki: The payout class this character counts as when killed in a mission that pays per kill. -1 for none. Retail: set on 109 DummyEnemies (0-4).

PartsTokenParamID.Wiki: The PartsTokenParam row the character drops. -1 for none. Retail: 0 on 1 DummyEnemy, -1 on the rest.

UnkEnemyStruct70.Wiki: Up to five directions the character looks around in while idle, used by the common non-battle AI (Lua GetInitialPointTurnAngle / NextInitialPointTurnAngle): within 10 m of its start point it turns to the current angle (degrees from its start facing), waits 5-7 seconds, then moves on to the next. Slots set to -1 are skipped. Retail: set on 1 DummyEnemy (45, 0, 45, 0).

TalkID.Wiki: No effect for a DummyEnemy: the talk script is read only by the Enemy setup step. Retail: set on 2 DummyEnemies (510, 10600000).

BackupEventAnimID.Wiki: No effect for a DummyEnemy: the idle animation is read only by the Enemy setup step. Retail: set on 71 DummyEnemies (1110-1117).

Enemy_Unk48.Wiki: No effect for a DummyEnemy: read only by the Enemy setup step. Retail: 0 on every DummyEnemy.

Enemy_Unk16.Wiki: No effect found: the game has a getter for it but nothing calls it. Retail: 0 on every DummyEnemy.

UnkEnemyStruct78.Wiki: No effect: fixed values the game does not read. Holds no editable values.

UnkStruct98.Wiki: No effect for a character. Holds no editable values.

UnkE3C.Wiki: No effect for a character: only asset code reads it. Retail: -1 on every DummyEnemy.

UnkE3E.Wiki: No effect found: the game has a getter for it but nothing calls it. Retail: 0 on every DummyEnemy.
